text: EXECUTABLE-DOCS GATE GAP on exact 76c62e7. docs-site/package.json verify runs Astro check/build plus verbatim, figure and provenance scripts; it does not compile or execute any of the eight Scala examples or compare fresh stdout. examples/README.md accurately records older producer revisions (mostly 1cb64bd, alignment daefa36), and pages qualify the evidence, so this is not an honesty defect. It is a reproducibility gap for the requested library guide. Successor acceptance should add a repository-controlled replay court that, in an exported exact candidate or standalone clone, compiles every shown public-API program in its declared owning project, runs it, captures stdout deterministically, and byte-compares or deliberately refreshes the archived output and digest. The gate must fail on a stale accessor, changed output, test-helper/internal import, missing grakern pin, or example omitted from the manifest. npm static verification remains separate; a green Astro build must not imply Scala examples ran. A script using temporary generated source paths is sufficient if it leaves the repository clean; a new sbt module or dependency requires separate chief approval.
